metadata.inclusion_rule: A cell is included when its centre lies inside the pilot boundary, OR when at least min_area_fraction of the cell's area falls inside it. Every indicator is then computed over the CLIPPED geometry (cell intersect boundary), never the whole hexagon, so no cell can carry values from outside the pilot area. Cells must cover at least 99% of the boundary area. Revised in P1-02 from an original 0.50 threshold; see DECISIONS.md D15.
metadata.indicators_use: the clipped geometry (cell intersect boundary), not the hexagon
